main.content:
<onlyinclude>
A '''feedback loop''' is a process where outputs of an action are "fed back" to modify the next action. Feedback loops are fundamental to cybernetic systems and appear in biological, mechanical, and social systems. Positive feedback amplifies change, while negative feedback dampens change to maintain equilibrium.
</onlyinclude>
